bug_semantics: GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch/workflow_call inputs were interpolated with ${{ }} inside run: scripts. Expression expansion happens before the shell parser, so a write-privileged attacker can break out of the intended command (e.g. next_version=1.0.0"; curl …; echo ") and execute arbitrary shell with contents:write / pull-requests:write. GHSA-3g6g-gq4r-xjm9 counts 10 sinks: maven-version.yml (4 next_version interpolations), cherrypick.yml (5 commits/branch interpolations), maven-release.yml (1 release_suffix interpolation into awk). CVE-2026-35580 is PUBLISHED (CNA GitHub_M, CWE-77); not withdrawn. First patched package is 8.39.0 via env-var indirection (PR #1286); regex validation (PR #1288) is later defense-in-depth.
flaw_origin: The injection pattern was first written when PR #519 added maven-version.yml and maven-release.yml. The GitHub squash landing on master is 114d8967a9d3ec783aea00a95f47244a9ec410da; reconstructing refs/pull/519/head yields five members, of which 1bea2e57d6121ad699f4eace0ced56726dfc38b2 is the smallest first-write (parent 1f9efac114f5c1933721396e749295bc121c3817 has no those files). The maven-version.yml and maven-release.yml blobs at that member are byte-identical to the squash carrier. Later same-mechanism sinks in cherrypick.yml (e7f0a29b7250309ffcc467ff29d53f20848fa172 / PR #537) reuse the same ${{ inputs }}-in-run: pattern and are not a separate first-write of the class.

reasoning: The advisory is a real CWE-77 GitHub Actions shell-injection: untrusted workflow inputs expanded by ${{ }} inside run: blocks, which the shell then parses. CVE-2026-35580 is PUBLISHED, so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE. On first-parent history the first appearance of github.event.inputs.next_version / release_suffix in workflows is squash 114d8967 (PR #519). That squash is not the BIC. PR members are reconstructable from GitHub and exist in the clone; 1bea2e57 is the smallest commit that added the two original vulnerable files, its parent tree lacks those paths, later #519 members do not edit the injection lines, and the file blobs transfer byte-identically onto the squash carrier that then reaches 8.0.0-M1 through 8.38.0. cherrypick.yml is the same mechanism added later (PR #537) and does not displace this first-write. The closing change is PR #1286 env-var indirection: atomic member 38ab53e, mainline squash d1d39fc, first release 8.39.0; #1288 validation is extra and lands in 8.40.0. AI attribution is taken only from the BIC commit object: human author/committer dev-mlb, no AI trailers or bot identity, so the verdict is NOT_AI.
